steps.sql: SELECT "user_id", "age", "country" FROM "users" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1000
SELECT "product_id", "category", "price" FROM "products" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1000
SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "product_id", "quantity", "ordered_at" FROM "orders" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*), MIN("ordered_at"), MAX("ordered_at"), COUNT("ordered_at")
FROM "orders"

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "users"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "product_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "product_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "products"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "orders"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("ordered_at") as min_date,
  MAX("ordered_at") as max_date
FROM "orders"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "products" WHERE "product_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__) as __kumo_matches__, "product_id", "price"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "products" ent
  ON ent.rowid = (
    SELECT rowid
    FROM "products"
    WHERE "product_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__
    ORDER BY "price", "product_id", rowid
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT "ordered_at" FROM "orders" WHERE "ordered_at" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_time__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "order_id", "user_id", "product_id", "quantity", "ordered_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "orders" fact
ON fact.rowid IN (
  SELECT rowid
  FROM "orders"
  WHERE "product_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
  AND "ordered_at" <= tmp.__kumo_time__
  ORDER BY "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"
  LIMIT 32
)
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "user_id", "age", "country"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "users" ent
  ON ent.rowid = (
    SELECT rowid
    FROM "users"
    WHERE "user_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__
    ORDER BY "age", "country", "user_id", rowid
    LIMIT 1
)
